integrity: Exact universal proof and finite numerical checks; no claim of external or independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Proof applies only to nonsingular spatial parallelotopes and independent volume-uniform points under Euclidean distance. The sixth coefficient is an exact integral; the cubic clipping formula is one-sided at the first threshold, not a full distribution. Historical priority may depend on unindexed literature.
title: Cubic clipping threshold and angular rigidity for random distances in spatial parallelotopes
